exposure.needed: whether Flux Operator deploys the Flux controllers, and whether the cluster still stores Flux resources at the removed v1beta1/v2beta1 API versions (the evidence does not name the affected kinds)

consequence.statement: The Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 have been removed from the CRDs. Clusters that do not use Flux Operator to deploy the Flux controllers must run `flux migrate` before upgrading to 2.7.0.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on each cluster before upgrading, following the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 removes the v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs from the CRDs. Unless Flux Operator deploys the Flux controllers, operators must run `flux migrate` on their clusters before upgrading.
